q: Did games with smaller crowds coincide with smaller national TV audiences in 2025 and 2026?
title: MLB attendance and national TV audiences, 2025-2026
cited: Yes, games with smaller crowds tended to have smaller national TV audiences, but a crowd that was small for its own park did not clearly mean a smaller audience (table: crowd_tv_headline). Comparing games on the same network, the two moved together (correlation 0.34 in 2025, n = 82, range 0.14 to 0.52; 0.47 in 2026, n = 83, range 0.29 to 0.62) (table: crowd_tv_headline). After comparing each game with its own park's usual crowd, the link mostly disappears (0.16 in 2025, range -0.05 to 0.37; 0.14 in 2026, range -0.08 to 0.34; both ranges include zero) (table: crowd_tv_headline). Across team-seasons, teams with higher average home attendance also tended to have larger average national TV audiences (correlation 0.51, n = 56, range 0.29 to 0.68) (table: team_crowd_tv). This is consistent with team-level factors such as popularity and market size, but the data does not show that one causes the other.

q: Compare the Cubs and White Sox on attendance and national TV audiences in 2025.
title: Cubs and White Sox attendance and TV, 2025
cited:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the Chicago White Sox in 2025, outdrawing them by 19,187 fans per game and drawing a massive national television audience while the White Sox had none (table: team_season_model; table: team_tv_summary; query: Q6).

### Attendance
The Cubs averaged 37,259 fans per game, which was 320 fans above what their prior crowds, win rate, and market would predict (table: team_season_model; query: Q3). Wrigley Field drew 89.9% of capacity (table: games_clean), bringing their season total to 3,017,983 fans, 1,572,245 more fans than their crosstown rivals overall (table: team_season_model; query: Q5, Q3, Q6). Meanwhile, the White Sox averaged 18,072 fans per game, which was 1,548 fans below what their prior crowds, win rate, and market would predict (table: team_season_model; query: Q3). Guaranteed Rate Field drew 45.0% of capacity (table: games_clean) for a total of 1,445,738 fans (table: team_season_model; query: Q5, Q3).

### National TV Audiences
The Cubs averaged 1,126,444 viewers across their 15 national TV appearances in 2025 (table: team_tv_summary). The White Sox had no national TV broadcasts in the 2025 data (table: team_tv_summary).

title: Rays attendance drop causes, 2024 to 2025
cited: The Tampa Bay Rays averaged 9,713 fans a game in 2025 down 41.2% from 16,515 the season before (table: team_season_model). A model prediction for this season is unavailable because the team played in a temporary ballpark (table: team_season_model). This shift coincided with Hurricane Milton heavily damaging Tropicana Field, rendering it unusable for the entire season ([2025 Tampa Bay Rays season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Tampa_Bay_Rays_season)). Instead, the Rays played their 81 home games at George M. Steinbrenner Field, a spring training park in Tampa ([2025 Tampa Bay Rays season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_Tampa_Bay_Rays_season)). While total home attendance fell by 550,989 fans (table: team_season_model, team_season_attendance), the Rays drew a higher share of capacity in 2025 at 88.1% compared to 66.0% of capacity in 2024, a gap of 22.1 percentage points (table: games_clean; query: Q6, Q3).

q: Which team had the most home games with more than 40,000 fans in 2025?
title: MLB attendance over 40,000 by team, 2025
cited: The Los Angeles Dodgers had the most home games with more than 40,000 fans in 2025, reaching that mark in all 81 games (table: games_clean, teams; query: Q1). This means every single one of their 81 home games drew over 40,000 fans, with crowds ranging from 40,094 fans to 54,154 fans (table: games_clean; query: Q3). No other team in baseball kept every home crowd above 40,000; the team with the next highest floor was the New York Yankees, whose lowest home crowd was 35,278 fans (table: games_clean; query: Q5).
